current_activity: Imamura arrives and establishes 8th Area Army headquarters at Rabaul
notes: Miller, ch. XV: Gen. Hitoshi Imamura, commanding the 8th Area Army, left Java to assume control of operations in the Solomons and Eastern New Guinea and arrived at Rabaul on 2 December 1942. The headquarters is at Rabaul, not on Guadalcanal. Theater pacific, sub_theater southwest_pacific (Bismarck Archipelago). The operation field is OP-FRONT-PACIFIC, not OP-CAMP-GUADALCANAL, because the headquarters is at Rabaul (southwest_pacific) and that campaign operation is south_pacific only. Commander is left unknown on the row; naming Imamura would need a person, tenure and commander-claim triple that is not added in this increment. Confidence 0.5: Miller only in this increment.
